query: EAU project website environment agent user co-evolution
text:
1. **Official EAU project website** — The exact match. People: Min Cai (University of Alberta), Dan Zhang (National University of Singapore), Gao Xing and Libin Ma (Kuaishou Technology), Zhaohui Xu (independent researcher), and Xi Ye (University of Alberta; Alberta Machine Intelligence Institute/Amii).  
   URL: https://eau-meta-agent.github.io/

2. **EAU paper on arXiv** — Primary research paper describing the environment–agent–user co-evolution framework. Same authors and affiliations as above; Min Cai and Dan Zhang are equal contributors.  
   URL: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16523

3. **Min Cai’s research page** — Lead author’s page listing EAU under agent training. Min Cai is a PhD student at the University of Alberta advised by coauthor Xi Ye.  
   URL: https://henrycai11.github.io/

The project site says its code is “coming soon (under review),” so no public implementation appears to be available yet.

query: framework jointly adapts simulated user environment rewards RL configuration
text:
1. **EAU: Environment-Agent-User Co-evolution for Training User-Centric Agents** — Exact match: jointly adapts the user simulator, environment, reward design, and RL configuration. Min Cai (University of Alberta); Dan Zhang (National University of Singapore); Gao Xing and Libin Ma (Kuaishou Technology); Zhaohui Xu (independent researcher); Xi Ye (University of Alberta and Amii).  
   URL: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16523

2. **UserRL: Training Interactive User-Centric Agent via Reinforcement Learning** — Closely related framework combining simulated users, standardized environments, and configurable RL reward formulations. Cheng Qian and Heng Ji (University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign); Zuxin Liu, Akshara Prabhakar, Jielin Qiu, Zhiwei Liu, Haolin Chen, Shirley Kokane, Weiran Yao, Shelby Heinecke, Silvio Savarese, Caiming Xiong, and Huan Wang (Salesforce AI Research).  
   URL: https://lifelongagent.github.io/Project-Lifelong-Agent/UserRL/index.html

3. **SUBER: An RL Environment with Simulated Human Behavior for Recommender Systems** — Modular synthetic-user environment for training and evaluating RL recommender systems. Nathan Corecco, Giorgio Piatti, Luca A. Lanzendörfer, and Roger Wattenhofer (ETH Zürich); Flint Xiaofeng Fan (National University of Singapore).  
   URL: https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.01631

4. **Generative Adversarial User Model for Reinforcement Learning-Based Recommendation** — Earlier model-based RL work that jointly learns simulated user dynamics and a user reward function. Xinshi Chen (Georgia Tech, with work partly completed at Ant Financial); Shuang Li (Georgia Tech); Hui Li, Shaohua Jiang, and Yuan Qi (Ant Financial); Le Song (Georgia Tech and Ant Financial).  
   URL: https://proceedings.mlr.press/v97/chen19f.html
